proposals.evidence: DEDR 4985 gives Tamil mulai, Malayalam mula, Kannada/Kodagu mole and Kota mel ‘breast’. The article specifically identifies Kota mol as borrowed from Badaga, so that exact Kota variant is held rather than treated as inherited. This is a comparative family proposal; inheritance versus local transmission in this survey lect remains subject to review.

Only this simple leaf stem is selected; the article's Gondi koṛk-ila ‘new leaf’ is a compound and is not reduced to a single inherited stem here. This is a comparative family proposal; inheritance versus local transmission in this survey lect remains subject to review.
